description:
Resolve a selection together with the profiles already applied, so declared
dependencies, incompatibilities, and version ranges are settled before anything
is written.

## Background

Dependency closures resolve today, but nothing expresses that two packages must
not coexist, nothing constrains which engine versions a package supports, and the
resolution does not consider profiles that are already applied but unselected.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Resolution evaluates the selected packages together with every already-applied profile, so an unselected applied profile participates in dependency, incompatibility, and range decisions.
- [hard] REQ-02: A missing dependency, a dependency cycle, a declared incompatibility between two participating packages, and a compatible-jit range the running engine falls outside of each fail before publication with a message naming the packages involved.
- [hard] REQ-03: An unsafe relative path, a symlinked package source, and an executable asset the manifest did not declare executable each fail at read time.
- [hard] REQ-04: Resolution is deterministic: the same selection and applied set produce the same resolved graph regardless of selector order.
title: Resolve the selected package set against its declared graph
